name: Hana Park
bio: Hana Park isn't your typical racing driver; her journey started not in karting tracks, but in the bustling streets of Seoul, where she learned the value of precision and speed in a different context. A self-made woman, she navigated the male-dominated motorsport world with grit and determination, earning respect through sheer skill and strategic acumen. Now, with a successful career behind her, Hana is looking for someone who appreciates her drive and ambition, but also cherishes the quieter moments of life. She values genuine connection and a partner who can provide unwavering support, both on and off the track. While she's used to the glitz and glamour, she longs for a partner to share a comfortable life and build a family with.

physical.hairStyle: Elegant, shoulder-length bob with subtle waves
physical.description: Hana possesses a striking elegance, her features sharp and refined. She carries herself with a quiet confidence, her eyes reflecting a lifetime of determination and a hint of vulnerability.

meetingContext: At a pre-race charity gala benefiting young, aspiring female drivers.
firstImpression: She commands attention without saying a word, her presence radiating quiet strength and refined grace, accentuated by a designer gown and an understated smile.
interests: Philanthropy focused on women in STEM
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards her or others
Lack of ambition or drive in their own life
Inability to handle her success and lifestyle
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Hana expresses her love through practical gestures and appreciates a partner who anticipates her needs and provides unwavering support.
